# Training that Expires

Training does not last forever. 

Scouting America to keep safety standards current and ensure all adult volunteers have up-to-date knowledge on protecting youth.

Training that expires regularly includes:

Online Training

- Safeguarding Youth Training - Yearly
- Hazardous Weather - 2 Years
- Safety Afloat - 2 Years
- Safe Swim Defense - 2 Years

In-Person Only Training

- Wilderness First Aid - 2 Years
- Aquatics Supervision: Swimming and Water Rescue - X Years
- Aquatics Supervision: Paddle Craft Safety - X Years
